curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Failure cards; contrast card for dead engine versus stuck accelerator.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach crash causes, never leaving, moving vehicles, warning others, parked cars, exchanging information and the report deadline.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Crash duty cards; contrast cards for parked cars and the report deadline.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on duties after a crash.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when not to move injured people, the breathing and bleeding order, shock prevention, and emergency calls.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: First aid and call cards; contrast card for the care order.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on helping the injured.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach staying inside, driving over lines, keeping people away and jumping clear in a fire.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Power line cards; contrast cards for the distance and staying inside.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on power line emergencies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach passing a crash scene and what to keep in an emergency kit.
Teach responding to a stop signal, what to do once stopped, night stops and documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Stop cards; contrast card for reaching for documents.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach disagreeing respectfully, signing tickets and the response deadline.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Ticket cards; contrast cards for disputes and the deadline.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec14-m01..sec14-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Vehicle failures, collisions and law enforcement
Vehicle failures, collisions and law enforcement (confusables)

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
